jd_text: AI Software Engineer role building backend services for our GenAI product suite. 1-3 years of experience with Python, FastAPI, and REST APIs. You will integrate LLM APIs into our platform, build event-driven pipelines with Redis, and store data in PostgreSQL. Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines is a plus.

Backend Engineer for a fully remote team building GenAI-powered data products. 2 years of experience with Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB required. You will build and maintain REST APIs, integrate LLM APIs for our data pipeline, and use Git/GitHub for our engineering workflow.

LLM Engineer role focused on building GenAI-powered internal tools. 3 years of experience in Python and LLM-based application development. You will build RAG pipelines using LangChain, integrate vector databases, and work with the Gemini API for our core product features.

AI Software Engineer role focused on our GenAI-powered consumer product. 2 years of experience with React.js and Next.js for building AI-powered interfaces, plus some backend experience with Django. You will collaborate with the AI research team on new generative features and prompt engineering workflows.

Backend Engineer to build GenAI-powered infrastructure services. 2 years of experience with AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform required, along with Python for automation scripting. You will support our LLM serving infrastructure and own reliability for internal AI Engineer tooling.

AI Software Engineer to build autonomous AI agents for our GenAI platform. 2 years of experience with Python, LangChain, and prompt engineering. You will design multi-step AI agent workflows using MCP, integrate with the Gemini API, and build supporting REST APIs in FastAPI.

LLM Engineer role for our GenAI data platform. 2 years of experience with SQL, MySQL, and data pipeline development required. Familiarity with LLM integration and RAG techniques is a strong plus, along with basic Python scripting for automation.

Backend Engineer for our GenAI-powered SaaS product. 3 years of experience with TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, and PostgreSQL. You will build APIs powering our AI Agents, integrate LLM Integration workflows using LangChain, and collaborate on CI/CD pipeline improvements using Docker.

AI Software Engineer to build GenAI features for our mobile app. 2 years of experience with Swift and Kotlin for native mobile development required, plus some exposure to on-device LLM inference and Core ML. You will work closely with the platform team on model integration.

AI Software Engineer building GenAI tooling for internal developer platforms. 1-2 years of experience with Python and TypeScript. You will build MCP servers, integrate the Gemini API and LangChain into our internal agent framework, and maintain our CI/CD pipelines on GitHub.
